verdict.rationale: DBOS stores all workflow checkpoints in your own Postgres system database, with no separate orchestration server (dbos-docs-2, dbos-docs-23). Conductor and the Console can also be self-hosted (dbos-docs-34). Together these imply you hold the data and could delete it yourself. However, no documented retention policy, garbage-collection setting, or workflow-data deletion API appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented retention/TTL configuration, explicit workflow-history deletion or garbage-collection commands, managed-Conductor/Cloud data deletion policy, independent corroboration.
